textTemplates.text:
• Statement of Work – A formal proposal for signature, outlining the project's scope, investment, timeline, and agreement terms.
  • Project Status Update – A summary of the project's status and overall health, including milestones achieved, planned milestones, and identified risks or dependencies.
  • Functional Design Document – A finalized document detailing the functional design based on requirements gathered during the solution planning phase. 
  • ERD (Data Model) – A finalized Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD) representing the project's data model and configurations. 
  • Process Flow – A visual representation of the process flow, designed based on project requirements and configurations. 
  • Configuration Workbook – A completed workbook outlining all Salesforce configurations implemented in the project. 
  • Test Scenarios – A compiled list of relevant test scenarios, aligning with the project's requirements and configurations. 
  • Test Scripts – A compiled list of relevant test scripts, aligning with the project's requirements and configurations. 
  • End User Documentation – A structured training guide outlining key business processes, user responsibilities, and step-by-step instructions, supported by screenshots, to enable effective adoption and consistent use of the configured Salesforce solution.
  • Administrative Documentation – A comprehensive admin training document covering platform configuration, best practices, and administrative guidelines based on functionality implemented during the project.
  • Fully Configured Application – A Salesforce environment configured in a production organization, incorporating all features specified in the Statement of Work.
